description: Open, verified shop database for AI agents: products, offers, price comparison, trust and coupons.

headers.description: Per-consumer OpenShopGraph API key (issued on request). Required only for get_trust and report_code — find_shop, get_shop, list_coupons and get_shipping_policy work without it (UCP permissionless read access). Unauthenticated calls to the two gated tools are rejected with 401.
